commits.comment: 较大的 MoE 激活泛化改动。新增 masked_moe_activation CUDA kernel，同时支持 [T,d] 扁平布局和 [E,T,d] batched-experts 布局，覆盖 silu/gelu/silu_with_clamp/situ/swigluoai/swigluoai_uninterleave/swiglustep/silu_no_mul/gelu_no_mul/gelu_tanh_no_mul/relu2_no_mul 等激活；引入 get_masked_row_range grid-stride 机制。Python 侧将 apply_moe_activation / FusedMoEExpertsModular.activation / situ_and_mul / situ_and_mul_quant 的参数 valid_rows 重命名为 valid_token_counts / num_valid_tokens，并新增 _apply_moe_activation_masked 分发。BatchedTritonExperts 对非 XPU 平台直接走 masked 路径，marlin_moe 也接入统一激活分发；preprocessTopkIdKernel 增加了对非法 expert id 的容错。C++ kernel + Python API 签名均有变更，风险中等。

[ROCm][DSpark][DCP] Serve prefix cache hits under DCP for Kimi-K3 (#53598)

Signed-off-by: Yichao Zhu <Yichao.Zhu@amd.com>
Co-authored-by: andyluo7 <andy.luo@amd.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py: AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.__init__ — must construct single_type_managers with per-group dcp_world_size = dcp_world_size_for_kv_cache_spec(spec, dcp_world_size) and propagate cache_hit_alignment_tokens to each manager (upstream now does this in KVCacheCoordinator.__init__/HybridKVCacheCoordinator.__init__)

vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py: AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.find_longest_cache_hit — must pass per-manager dcp_world_size/pcp_world_size (self.single_type_managers[group_ids[0]].dcp_world_size/.pcp_world_size) instead of process-wide self.dcp_world_size + pcp_world_size=1, and reconcile _cache_hit_alignment_tokens with the new per-manager cache_hit_alignment_tokens (WRITE path)

vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py: _get_effective_block_size / _cache_hit_alignment_tokens — block-size and alignment computation must follow the new per-group DCP geometry (FullAttention/MLA sharded → dcp; Mamba/SWA replicated → 1)

vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_mamba_manager.py: AscendMambaManager — inherits new cache_hit_alignment_tokens (defaults to scheduler_block_size) used in reachable_block_mask WRITE path; must stay consistent with dcp_world_size=1 for replicated Mamba groups under DCP

vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_utils.py: _ascend_resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes — verify per-group DCP block-size resolution is consistent with the new dcp_world_size_for_kv_cache_spec semantics for hybrid DCP+Mamba configs

vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py, vllm_ascend/core/dyntra_lb_scheduler.py, vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_balance_schedule.py — callers of coordinator.find_longest_cache_hit_per_group; method now derives dcp/pcp from per-manager state, results must match AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.find_longest_cache_hit
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Commit 2ba984a5d06d introduces per-KV-cache-group DCP geometry for prefix cache hits under DCP (Kimi-K3/DSpark): (1) new helper vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py:dcp_world_size_for_kv_cache_spec (FullAttention/MLAAttention/UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs-of-attention keep process DCP size; Mamba/sliding-window/chunked-local get 1); (2) KVCacheCoordinator.__init__ now builds each SingleTypeKVCacheManager with that per-group dcp_world_size, and UnitaryKVCacheCoordinator derives block_size/dcp_world_size from single_type_managers[0]; (3) new SingleTypeKVCacheManager.cache_hit_alignment_tokens (default scheduler_block_size) drives reachable_block_mask in cache_blocks, and HybridKVCacheCoordinator.__init__ sets it to _cache_hit_alignment_tokens on all managers; (4) find_longest_cache_hit / _adjust_eagle_verified / find_longest_cache_hit_per_group now pass per-manager dcp_world_size and pcp_world_size. vllm-ascend replaces all of this in patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py (AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator) and patch/platform/patch_mamba_manager.py, so it will NOT inherit the new behavior and its Mamba managers would keep process-wide dcp_world_size. Required changes: (a) in AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.__init__, import and apply dcp_world_size_for_kv_cache_spec per group when building managers, and set mgr.cache_hit_alignment_tokens = self._cache_hit_alignment_tokens for all managers (mirroring upstream); (b) in find_longest_cache_hit, pass manager.dcp_world_size / manager.pcp_world_size into manager_cls.find_longest_cache_hit instead of self.dcp_world_size and pcp_world_size=1; (c) keep _get_effective_block_size/_cache_hit_alignment_tokens in sync with the per-group geometry so the WRITE path (reachable_block_mask) aligns with READ-path hits; (d) verify AscendMambaManager and the ascend_store KV-transfer coordinator (distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/ascend_store/coordinator.py) behave with dcp_world_size=1 and the new alignment default; (e) validate the custom schedulers (recompute/dyntra/balance) against find_longest_cache_hit_per_group's new per-manager sizes. No signature changes were introduced, so there is no hard crash risk, but the DCP prefix-cache-hit feature and per-group alignment correctness on NPU depend on this adaptation. Add regression coverage mirroring the new tests (test_prefix_cache_hit_uses_per_group_dcp_geometry, test_dcp_fine_hit_retention_uses_hash_alignment_without_eagle) on the Ascend coordinator.
deep_analysis.risk: Without adaptation, vllm-ascend's overridden coordinator keeps process-wide DCP sizing for every group, so (a) the new DCP prefix-cache-hit serving for Kimi-K3 DSpark (sharded target/draft MLA + replicated Mamba) will not align to the sharded full-attention block, losing the feature and any future correctness fix tied to per-group alignment; (b) Mamba managers under DCP retain dcp_world_size>1 while upstream semantics now require 1, which can diverge between AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.find_longest_cache_hit and the upstream find_longest_cache_hit_per_group used by Ascend's custom schedulers (recompute/dyntra/balance), producing inconsistent hit lengths/block counts; (c) since AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.__init__ does not set cache_hit_alignment_tokens, the WRITE path stays at scheduler_block_size granularity and will not match the READ-path _cache_hit_alignment_tokens (hash_block_size when enable_partial_hash_hits), mirroring the exact bug the commit's tests guard against. The changes are additive with safe defaults, so the risk is functional divergence and silent misbehavior rather than startup/runtime crashes.

commits.comment: 变更意图：为 ROCm AITER MLA 在 DCP 下支持因果多 token 验证（MTP/draft verify），当日最大 commit（+1105/-111）。实现方式：(1) 新增 segmented MLA decode 路由：按 DCP rank 将 KV shard 切成子页（_segmented_mla_page_size 取 physical block 最大 2 幂约数，上限 128），为每个 verify token 构建一行 paged-KV 的因果局部长度（dcp_local_verify_row_lens），调用 AITER segmented mla_decode_fwd(skip_reduce=True) 得到 split-K partials，再经新增 triton kernel merge_mla_segments_triton 归并为 output + 自然对数 LSE，供跨 rank LSE merge；(2) DCP qlen=1 decode 改走 aiter 原生 mla_decode_fwd(return_lse=True) 以获取 LSE；(3) builder 在元数据上记录路由决策（dcp_verify/use_gluon_verify），impl 不再自行推导；引入 dcp_world_size 相关的 head 计数（_decode_num_heads）；(4) RocmPlatform 中 full CUDA graph 不再因 DCP 降级为 PIECEWISE（仅 PCP 保留降级）。测试覆盖行视图因果性、跨 rank 窗口覆盖、fp8 路由、LSE merge 与 MTP 拼帧等。变更集中在 ROCm 平台与 AITER 后端，不影响其他平台。

commits.comment: 变更意图：解决结构化输出（terminal grammar）与 min_tokens 的冲突——当 grammar 只剩 EOS/stop token 为合法 continuation 时，min_tokens 的 masking 会让整行 logits 全为 -inf，导致采样失败或请求无法停止。实现方式分三层：(1) 调度层：调整 check_stop 顺序，EOS/stop token 与 max_tokens/max_model_len 长度上限优先于 min_tokens，采样到的停止 token 即使未达 min_tokens 也终止请求；(2) 采样层：MinTokensLogitsProcessor 的 min_toks 内部元组新增 uses_structured_output 标志，对 structured_output 请求在 mask 后若整行 logits 全为 -inf，则恢复 stop token 的原始 logits（apply 与 apply_with_spec_decode 两条路径均支持）；(3) GPU v2 logit_bias Triton kernel 增加 restore_when_all_masked 与 CHECK_ALL_MASKED_ROWS，用 debug_barrier + 全行扫描检测整行被 mask 后恢复 stop logits。测试覆盖调度 stop 顺序、E2E terminal grammar、logits processor 恢复逻辑与 GPU logit bias kernel。check_stop 与 MinTokensLogitsProcessor 是平台共享代码，行为变化对所有平台生效，有一定回归风险。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/core/sched/utils.py 的 check_stop 顺序调整（EOS/stop token 与长度上限优先于 min_tokens）会被 vllm-ascend 自定义调度器（如 BalanceScheduler、ShortRequestFirstScheduler 等）继承，采样到 EOS/stop token 的请求将在未达 min_tokens 时提前终止。MinTokensLogitsProcessor 内部 min_toks 元组由 3 元组变为 4 元组（新增 uses_structured_output），vllm-ascend 的模型运行器/采样路径若直接访问该内部结构需同步适配；对 structured_output 请求的 stop-token logits 恢复逻辑是共享采样逻辑，Ascend 采样路径同样生效。vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/logit_bias.py 的 Triton kernel 为 GPU 专用，Ascend 有自己的采样/worker 实现，不直接受影响。
ascend_impact.testing: 需要验证 Ascend 上 min_tokens + structured_output 场景的停止行为：terminal grammar 下采样 EOS/stop token 能否在任何硬件上正常终止请求，以及 MinTokensLogitsProcessor 在 NPU 上的整行 -inf 恢复逻辑。
suggested_test_areas: vllm/v1/core/sched 停止条件测试（check_stop 顺序变化）
vllm/v1/sample/logits_processor 的 MinTokensLogitsProcessor structured_output 恢复测试
vllm_ascend worker/model_runner 采样路径的 min_tokens 与 structured_output 组合测试

[Structured Output] Let terminal grammars stop under min_tokens (II) (#54218)

Signed-off-by: Artem Perevedentsev <aperevedents@nvidia.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/sample/rejection_sampler.py::AscendRejectionSampler.apply_logits_processors (lines 144-146): calls MinTokensLogitsProcessor.apply_with_spec_decode whose behavior changed — for structured-output requests under min_tokens it now restores stop-token logits when masking would leave a row all -inf

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py::NPUModelRunnerV2 (inherits GPUModelRunner's GPU worker sampler): runs the modified vllm/v1/worker/gpu/sample/logit_bias.py LogitBiasState/apply_logit_bias/triton _bias_kernel on NPU, including the new CHECK_ALL_MASKED_ROWS branch with tl.debug_barrier() and an in-kernel row scan

vllm_ascend/core/*scheduler.py (BatchJobAwareScheduler, ShortRequestFirstScheduler, dyntra/recompute/etc.): inherit upstream Scheduler → check_stop in vllm/v1/core/sched/utils.py, whose check order changed so terminal grammars can stop under min_tokens
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: No interface/signature breakage — vllm-ascend overrides none of the 3 changed source modules, so everything flows through inherited/patched paths (no compile failures). Required work is verification plus a likely small triton-kernel patch: (1) In vllm_ascend/sample/rejection_sampler.py, verify the new MinTokensLogitsProcessor.apply_with_spec_decode restore path (torch index_put_/unique_consecutive/isneginf/isfinite) works with AscendRejectionSampler's custom spec-decode rejection kernels for structured-output + min_tokens requests; (2) verify the new _bias_kernel CHECK_ALL_MASKED_ROWS branch (uses tl.debug_barrier(), which vllm-ascend never uses today and the Ascend Triton backend may not support) compiles/runs on NPU when structured-output + min_tokens requests are batched; if unsupported, add an Ascend replacement e.g. vllm_ascend/worker/v2/sample/logit_bias.py and register it in vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py (existing pattern); (3) confirm the new restore_when_all_masked UvaBackedTensor works with the dummy UvaBufferWrapper in patch_v2/patch_uva.py (its .np accessor exists, so OK); (4) confirm the check_stop reordering is compatible with vllm-ascend custom schedulers and add an NPU e2e test for terminal-grammar stopping under min_tokens.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-medium. No compile-time breakage. Main risks are runtime/correctness on NPU: (a) the new _bias_kernel branch uses tl.debug_barrier() and an in-kernel row scan — if the Ascend Triton backend does not support debug_barrier or handles the constexpr branch differently, structured-output + min_tokens requests could fail to compile, hang, or sample incorrectly in the v2 path; (b) the stop-token restore logic assumes the grammar bitmask (applied by vllm_ascend/ops/triton/v2/apply_grammar_bitmask.py on NPU) has already masked all non-stop logits, and must behave identically when combined with AscendRejectionSampler's custom kernels; (c) behavioral change to check_stop alters when requests finish under min_tokens, affecting vllm-ascend schedulers and KV-block accounting.
